title: A must-read book for any creator
content:
This amazing Paul Arden piece of writing is a must-read book for anyone who strives for creativity, inspiration and has strong desire to explore their lives to the fullest. Creativity encourages us in every aspects of life, ranging from live, love, work and play. This is my pocket book which I keep at hand every when I need an inspiration dose. Paul wrote not too much, not lengthy or wordy, he wrote just enough for place of your own creativity. Creativity of each individual is not all the same, because it is not merely coming up at some ideas, most of all creativity lies on your knowledge and experience. Creativity, at its core, need to be practiced with very hard-working, spiced with some dose of inspiration and passion. Generally, I am pretty much into this book and the way its messages are conveyed. 
The title itself say it all, just think everything upside down, and you can be amazingly astonishing!

title: Whatever you think, think the Opposite
content:
Great book, not only for creative but also for people who have struggled between doing what everybody does or going their own way. Actions start with thinking. Paul Arden showed us not only interesting stories, history lessons but also a different view towards the world. There is no "right' or "wrong", it depends on each situation and point of views. He wrote in the simplest English that anyone could read and understand. His points were clear, straight forward and each word is actually worth to read again and again until they are embossed to your brain. This is not only about thinking, it's about a life and lifestyle you're gonna pick. An innovation book that everyone should read. 
Too bad it is currently out of stock in Tiki. Hopefully it will be restocked soon

title: So Creative!

Sách trình bày ngắn gọn, không quá khó để đọc, chỉ là những đoạn ngắn, đôi khi chỉ là những câu slogan đúng kiểu ngành quảnh cáo, nhưng lại chứa rất nhiều thông điệp. Những hình ảnh minh họa rất thú vị, có lẽ cần phải có 1 đầu óc tưởng tượng đủ mạnh để có thể hiểu hết nội dung của những bức ảnh. Cuốn sách thể hiện lối suy nghĩ  của tác giả, không theo những lối mòn, táo bạo và cũng rất logic. Một cuốn sách rất đáng đọc cho những ai đang cần sự sáng tạo, muốn tạo khác biệt.
